444:t_019:16.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Learn what that will bring forth, you who live for eternity.」

444:t_019:17.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Very well, Moon Queen. Then before your very eyes, I will trample the Wingless you put your faith in.」

444:t_019:18.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Are you still fighting out of hatred!?」

444:t_019:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence, winged dog. I will teach despair to you fools who believe time continues on into the future.」

444:t_019:20.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will put you to the test. To see whether you are worthy of taking part in the true battle.」

444:t_019:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Like hell it'll go your way! We'll connect the future with our own hands!」

444:t_020:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...That is enough. Your power can be put to use as well.」

444:t_020:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Running away? Watch your tongue, winged dog.」

444:t_020:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Besides, can you afford to be wasting your time on me?」

444:t_021:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain! We have an incoming message from Colonel $$ランスロー・ダーウェル$$ of the $$宇宙革命軍$$!」

444:t_021:1.en:
$$メラン$$
「They report a swarm of $$宇宙怪獣$$ is attacking the area around $$翠の地球$$!」

444:t_021:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Has $$バアル$$ finally launched a full-scale attack!?」

444:t_021:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What's so funny!? Just because you think you're a little good-looking, if you think that looking down on us and laughing is okay, you are dead wrong!」

444:t_021:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ignorance is folly... I shall wish you luck in your fight, you who battle without even knowing what $$バアル$$ is.」

444:t_022:1.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Ignore him! It's just his usual trick of stirring up our fears with big talk, I'm sure of it!」

444:t_022:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, return to base! We will leave the Moon at once and head out to intercept the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

444:t_022:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ジャミル$$ and the others will defend the Moon! We're going on the attack!」

444:t_022:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$! Please look after $$ディアナ$$!」

444:t_022:5.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Understood. I wish you the best in battle.」

444:t_022:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm on my way, $$ディアナ$$.」

444:t_022:7.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Do well, $$ロラン・セアック$$.」

444:t_022:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$ディアナ$$... To connect the future, I will use the power of the $$ホワイトドール$$.)

444:t_023:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Damn it! To show such a disgraceful performance on the battlefield Lady $$エルーナ$$ entrusted to me!」

444:t_023:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now there is nothing for it but to have Lady $$エルーナ$$ decide my fate!」

444:t_024:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So basically, he's going to go see $$エルーナルーナ$$, huh.」

444:t_024:1.en:
$$メール$$
「That guy turns into a total mess the second $$エルーナルーナ$$ gets involved.」

444:t_025:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「W-what!? There's somebody out here in a place like this!」

444:t_025:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Could that be $$コレン・ナンダー$$!?」

444:t_025:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What are you doing!? This is a battlefield!」

444:t_025:5.en:
$$コレン$$
「I, $$コレン・ナンダー$$, was a member of the $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ defense force, but unfortunately I was shot down.」

444:t_025:6.en:
$$コレン$$
「Yet Her Majesty's order to hold this place to the death still lives on in my heart!」

444:t_025:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You were going to fight with your bare hands!?」

444:t_025:8.en:
$$コレン$$
「There are plenty of ways to fight.」

444:t_025:10.en:
$$コレン$$
「But if you have come, then there is no longer any need for me to step in.」

444:t_025:11.en:
$$コレン$$
「I entrust you with this in my place.」

444:t_026:1.en:
$$コレン$$
「Don't worry about it. It's meaningless for me to hold on to it now. In exchange...」

444:t_026:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes! I will definitely protect the Moon!」

444:t_100:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ランド・トラビス$$! I will defeat you with my own hands!」

444:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit mixing up jealousy and a sense of duty! You're pathetic, $$ダバラーン$$!」

444:t_100:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Silence! How could a crude man like you ever understand my feelings for Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

444:t_100:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Geez... Looks like $$エルーナルーナ$$ wasn't the only one whose personality changed after taking off the armor...!」

444:t_101:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sinful Wingless. You still do not seem to realize how foolish your actions are.」

444:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know what you're talking about, but I won't hand over $$シェリル$$ or $$ランカ$$ to you!」

444:t_101:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's fine. Two women and one man... That is exactly what will spin my dream.」

444:t_102:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Stop fighting, $$ミカゲ$$! I won't let your hatred engulf this world!」

444:t_102:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Winged dog. I have no intention of listening to the words of the likes of you.」

444:t_102:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Then I'll stop you by force!」

444:t_102:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll show you just how powerful the love you refuse to acknowledge is!!」

444:t_103:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence...! If it weren't for you, there would have been no problem at all!」

444:t_103:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Mechanical Angel has already fallen into my hands! Once I dispose of you, a ten-thousandth of my hatred will be quenched!」

444:t_104:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come, you fake $$頭翅#pilot$$! With my love for $$ティファ$$, there's nothing I'm afraid of!」

444:t_104:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A Wingless has no business talking about love.」

444:t_104:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're jealous, aren't you!? That's pathetic, man!」

444:t_104:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You want to make me angry that badly...? Then I shall grant you the cruelest death!」

444:t_104:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「A threat like that won't scare me! I keep telling you, I'm not afraid of anything!」

444:t_105:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who bear the wings of destruction...」

444:t_105:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I don't deny those words...! But the power of $$ターンエー$$ is not only that!」

444:t_105:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$ホワイトドール$$ was the guardian deity of $$ビシニティ$$! And now, it protects the world for us!」

444:t_106:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even though we're apart, I can feel $$ティファ$$ close to me...」

444:t_106:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I've got nothing to be afraid of anymore! For $$ティファ$$'s sake too, I'll definitely get it done!!」

ランスロー・ダーウェル.evidence: Space Revolutionary Army colonel named in Meran's line 444:t_021:0; not in the glossary. Katakana transliteration; spelling of Lancelot Dahwell unverified.
